about_the_game:
"Life Bug"

This is a 2D combat game where you can fight monsters and grow. Challenge enemies stronger than you, poisonous swamps, complex nests, and sieges by thousands of monsters. Use your limited skills to explore the underground and uncover the truth.

Explore the world downward "Life Bug"

Feel a unique world, a bunch of exciting puzzles waiting for you! Attack, launch, food, strike, pass through the walls of various areas, explore the power of up, down, left and right, a simple exploration game.

Any monster in the world can become your experience. Accumulate experience, become bigger and stronger, complete the game, and then get the experience of completing the game, tactical retreat, start over, move in the air, pass through the wall, etc., understand the characteristics of the enemy to win. Embark on a real adventure of failure and complete the success to leave this world.
